faqs.q: How do I automate my business with AI?
faqs.a: Begin with repetitive, time-consuming processes (data entry, customer queries, reports, document processing, lead qualification), pick one or two high-impact ones, measure results, then expand.

faqs.q: What does AI automation cost for a small business?
faqs.a: Roughly $2,000 for a simple workflow up to $25,000+ for multi-system integration; a chatbot is typically $3,000-$15,000; maintenance $200-$1,000/month. Payback usually within 3-9 months.

faqs.q: How long does AI integration take?
faqs.a: Chatbot: about 3-4 weeks. Workflow automation: 4-6 weeks. Complex multi-system or custom-model work: 3-6 months, with phased rollouts.

faqs.q: Is AI automation safe for my business data?
faqs.a: Encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, security reviews, compliance with India's DPDP Act and GDPR where applicable, and no training on your data without consent.

faqs.q: What is the difference between AI automation and traditional automation?
faqs.a: Traditional automation follows fixed if-then rules; AI automation handles variable, language-heavy or judgment-based tasks.

faqs.q: Which business processes should I automate with AI first?
faqs.a: High-volume, repetitive, time-consuming ones with some unstructured data: customer inquiries, document extraction, lead scoring, reporting, scheduling.

faqs.q: What ROI can I expect from AI automation?
faqs.a: Typical payback in 3-9 months; support costs down 25-40%, document processing time down 60-80%, lead-scoring efficiency up 20-35%, 10-25 hours saved weekly per automated process.

faqs.q: Can AI automation work with my existing software and tools?
faqs.a: Yes: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Slack, Teams, Google Workspace and more, with custom connectors where needed.
